name: mostly-recipes

interface.longDescription: Save recipes from your conversations to your Mostly Recipes cookbook. Ask ChatGPT to save a recipe you worked out together, or one from a recipe link, and it’s in your cookbook the next time you open Mostly Recipes. ChatGPT can also show the recipes it saved for you. It can’t see or change your other recipes. Requires a Mostly Account.
defaultPrompt: Save this recipe to my Mostly Recipes cookbook.
Create a weeknight vegetarian chili recipe and save it to Mostly Recipes.
Show the recipes you’ve saved to my Mostly Recipes cookbook.

review.commerce_description: The four plugin tools are free within the user's normal Mostly Recipes account limits. The plugin does not sell products, initiate purchases, or promote paid upgrades.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release with recipe saving from conversations and public links, plus listing and retrieving recipes sent through this connection.

description: Save recipes from chat and public recipe links to Mostly Recipes.
